from rcb_traj import Session
import numpy as np

s = Session('place_a2b_right', instance='/app/instance.json')
env = s.env
from envs.utils import ArmTag
A, B = env.object, env.target_object
pa, pb = A.get_pose(), B.get_pose()
print('A', env.selected_modelname_A, env.selected_model_id_A, pa.p, pa.q)
print('B', env.selected_modelname_B, env.selected_model_id_B, pb.p, pb.q)
arm = ArmTag('right' if pa.p[0] > 0 else 'left')
# goal center 13 cm to the right of B, aligned in y; keep current object's height/orientation
pgoal = np.array([pb.p[0] + 0.13, pb.p[1], pa.p[2]], dtype=float)
target = pgoal.tolist() + pa.q.tolist()
s.record_start()
# Execute native grasp and placement planning primitives.
print('contacts', list(A.iter_contact_points()))
print('grasp poses', env.choose_grasp_pose(A, arm, pre_dis=0.12, target_dis=-0.12))
env.move(env.grasp_actor(A, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.12, grasp_dis=-0.12))
print('after grasp plan', env.plan_success, 'ee', env.get_arm_pose(arm), 'A', A.get_pose().p, 'gripper', env.robot.is_right_gripper_open())
print('computed place', env.get_place_pose(A, arm, target, constrain='free', pre_dis=0.025))
env.move(env.place_actor(A, arm, target, pre_dis=0.12, dis=0.025, is_open=True, constrain='free'))
print('after place plan', env.plan_success, 'A now', A.get_pose().p, 'success', env.check_success())
# Open the unused gripper as required by the predicate.
other = ArmTag('left' if arm == 'right' else 'right')
env.move(env.open_gripper(other))
actions = s.record_stop()
print('recorded', actions.shape, s.status())
if env.plan_success and env.check_success():
    print('replay', s.replay(actions))
    if s.status()['success']:
        s.save_trajectory(actions, '/app/output/trajectory.npz')
        print('SAVED')
